title: WhatsApp Booking Assistant for Hotels
summary: Answer availability and rate questions on WhatsApp, show rooms, take UPI advances and confirm bookings in your PMS, with staff stepping in for groups, negotiations and complaints.

seo.title: WhatsApp Booking Assistant for Hotels | VipraTech
seo.description: WhatsApp booking assistant for hotels: live availability and rates, room catalogue, UPI advance payment and instant confirmation, with staff handover.

problem.intro: For many Indian hotels, WhatsApp has become a main booking channel, fed by Google Business Profile, Instagram and repeat guests. But it is answered from the front desk phone between check-ins, so replies are slow, rates are quoted inconsistently and a guest who waited too long books the same hotel on an OTA.

pain_points.title: Slow replies during rush hours
pain_points.detail: The same person handles check-ins, calls and WhatsApp, so messages wait during the evening rush and late at night.

pain_points.title: Back-and-forth before a booking
pain_points.detail: Dates, number of guests, extra bed, meal plan and room photos take many messages, and guests drop off midway.

pain_points.title: Payment confusion
pain_points.detail: Advances are requested by sharing a UPI ID, guests send screenshots, and staff check the bank app later to match payments to bookings.

pain_points.title: Bookings outside the PMS
pain_points.detail: Rooms promised on WhatsApp are noted on paper or in the chat, leading to overbooking when an OTA booking lands for the same room.

solution.overview: We build a WhatsApp booking assistant on the WhatsApp Cloud API that handles the conversation from first message to confirmed booking. It asks for dates, guests and preferences, checks live availability and rates from your PMS or channel manager, and shows room types with photos, inclusions and meal plans. When the guest chooses, it places a short hold on the inventory, sends a UPI payment link or QR code for the advance and confirms the booking only after the payment gateway reports success. The voucher goes to the guest and the booking appears in the PMS. Staff take over in the same chat for groups, special requests, negotiations and complaints.
capabilities: Guided booking conversation in English, Hindi and Hinglish, with free-text understanding
Live availability and rates from the PMS or channel manager, plus direct-booking offers you set
Room catalogue with photos, inclusions, CP and MAP meal plans and policies
Timed inventory hold, UPI payment link or QR code and gateway-verified confirmation
Booking written to the PMS with a confirmation voucher sent on WhatsApp
Handover to staff in the same chat, with the conversation history visible

workflow.title: Guest starts a chat
workflow.detail: A guest messages from Google, Instagram, the website or a saved number, and the assistant greets them and asks for dates and guests.

workflow.title: Check availability and rates
workflow.detail: The assistant queries the PMS or channel manager and presents matching room types with rates and inclusions.

workflow.title: Select and hold
workflow.detail: The guest picks a room and meal plan, and the assistant places a timed hold on that inventory.

workflow.title: Collect the advance
workflow.detail: A UPI payment link or QR code is sent, and payment status comes from the gateway, not from screenshots.

workflow.title: Confirm or hand over
workflow.detail: On success the booking is created in the PMS and a voucher is sent; failed payments, groups and special requests go to staff.

workflow.title: Pre-arrival messages
workflow.detail: Before arrival the guest receives directions, check-in time and ID requirements, and can ask follow-up questions.

inputs: Guest WhatsApp messages, including voice notes
Live availability and rates from the PMS or channel manager
Room photos, inclusions, meal plans and policies
Direct-booking offers and rules set by the revenue manager
outputs: Payment records linked to each booking
human_in_the_loop: Front desk staff take over any conversation involving groups, special requests, negotiations, complaints or failed payments, and the revenue manager sets the rates and offers the assistant may quote.
integrations: Hotel PMS such as eZee, Hotelogix, IDS or Opera
Channel manager such as STAAH, AxisRooms or SiteMinder
Payment gateway with UPI, such as Razorpay, Cashfree or PayU
Google Business Profile and Instagram links to WhatsApp
guardrails: Bookings confirmed only after a gateway payment callback, never on a screenshot
Timed holds released automatically if payment does not arrive
Quotes only rates and offers returned by the PMS or set by the revenue manager
Hands over to staff whenever the guest asks for a person
Guest data stored in your account, with access limited to front office staff
compliance_notes: Business-initiated WhatsApp messages use approved templates and opt-in, per Meta's WhatsApp Business policies.
Guest contact details and payment references are processed for the booking purpose, with retention limits, under the DPDP Act 2023.

faqs.q: What if we do not have a PMS with an API?
faqs.a: We can start with a shared availability and rate sheet that the front desk updates, and the assistant reads it before quoting. It is less automatic than a live integration, so we keep holds short and have staff confirm bookings until a PMS connection is in place.

faqs.q: How do you stop fake payment screenshots?
faqs.a: The assistant ignores screenshots for confirmation. It waits for the payment gateway's success callback, linked to the booking reference. If a guest says they have paid and no callback has arrived, the chat goes to staff to check.

faqs.q: Will it undercut our OTA rates?
faqs.a: It quotes only what your PMS returns and the direct offers your revenue manager sets, so rate parity decisions stay with you. Some hotels prefer to offer a direct-booking benefit, such as breakfast or late check-out, rather than a lower rate.

faqs.q: Can it handle Hindi and Hinglish messages?
faqs.a: Yes. It understands mixed Hindi and English text, including the spellings guests commonly use, and replies in the guest's style. Voice notes can be transcribed and handled the same way.
